senses.gloss:
The substitutes एत and इत come instead of इदम् when a प्राग्दिशीय affix beginning with र and थ respectively follows.

Terms: प्राग्दिशीय - इदम्

The short is substituted for the vowel of the अङ्ग (stem) इ (एति) before the augment यास् in the Benedictive, when a preposition precedes it.

Terms: Shortening
